regex: 717049: Local CA Server certificate is due to expire in (?<number>\S+) days and a replacement certificate is available for export\.$
explanation: The administrator is alerted to an upcoming CA certificate expiration so that the administrator can take action to export the replacement certificate to all ASAs that will require the new certificate.

regex: 717052: Group (?<group_name>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip_address>\S+) Session disconnected due to periodic certificate authentication failure\. Subject Name (?<id_subject_name>\S+) Issuer Name (?<id_issuer_name>\S+) Serial Number (?<id_serial_number>\S+)$
explanation: Periodic certificate authentication failed, and the session was disconnected.

regex: 717053: Group (?<group_name>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip_address>\S+) Periodic certificate authentication succeeded\. Subject Name (?<id_subject_name>\S+) Issuer Name (?<id_issuer_name>\S+) Serial Number (?<id_serial_number>\S+)$
explanation: Periodic certificate authentication succeeded.

regex: 717054: The (?<type>\S+) certificate in the trustpoint (?<tp_name>\S+) is due to expire in (?<number>\S+) days\. Expiration (?<date_and_time>\S+) Subject Name (?<subject_name>\S+) Issuer Name (?<issuer_name>\S+) Serial Number (?<serial_number>\S+)$
explanation: The specified certificate in the trustpoint is about to expire.

regex: 717055: The (?<type>\S+) certificate in the trustpoint (?<tp_name>\S+) has expired\. Expiration (?<date_and_time>\S+) Subject Name (?<subject_name>\S+) Issuer Name (?<issuer_name>\S+) Serial Number (?<serial_number>\S+)$
explanation: The specified certificate in the trustpoint has expired.

regex: 717056: Attempting (?<type>\S+) revocation check from (?<src>\S+):(?<interface>\S+)/(?<src_2>\S+) to (?<ip>\S+)/(?<src_port>\S+) using (?<dst_ip>\S+)\.$
explanation: The CA was attempting to download a CRL or send an OCSP revocation check request.

regex: 717059: Peer certificate with (?<ph_0___serial_subject___ph_1___issuer___ph_2>\S+) matched the configured certificate map (?<map_name>\S+)$
explanation: This log is generated when an ASDM connection is authenticated via certificates and allowed based on the configured certificate map rules.

regex: 717060: Peer certificate with (?<ph_0___serial_subject___ph_1___issuer___ph_2>\S+) failed to match the configured certificate map (?<map_name>\S+)$
explanation: This log is generated when an ASDM connection is authenticated via certificates and not allowed based on the configured certificate map rules.

regex: 717061: Starting (?<protocol>\S+) certificate enrollment for the trustpoint (?<tpname>\S+) with the CA (?<ca_name>\S+)\. Request Type (?<type>\S+) Mode (?<mode>\S+)$
explanation: A CMP enrollment request has been triggered.

regex: 717062: (?<protocol>\S+) Certificate enrollment succeeded for the trustpoint (?<tpname>\S+) with the CA (?<ca>\S+) using CMP\. Received a new certificate with Subject Name (?<subject>\S+) Issuer Name (?<issuer>\S+) Serial Number (?<serial>\S+)$
explanation: CMP enrollment request succeeded. New certificate received.

regex: 717063: (?<protocol>\S+) Certificate enrollment failed for the trustpoint (?<tpname>\S+) with the CA (?<ca>\S+)$
explanation: CMP enrollment request failed.

regex: 717064: Keypair (?<keyname>\S+) in the trustpoint (?<tpname>\S+) is regenerated for (?<mode>\S+) (?<protocol>\S+) certificate enrollment$
explanation: The keypair in the trustpoint is regenerated for certificate enrollment using CMP.

regex: 717067: Starting ACME certificate enrollment for trustpoint (?<tpname>\S+) with CA (?<ca_name>\S+)\. Mode (?<mode>\S+)\.​$
explanation: The enrollment is triggered for ACME trustpoint.

regex: 717069: ACME Certificate enrollment failed for trustpoint (?<tpname>\S+) with CA (?<ca>\S+)\.$
explanation: The ACME certificate enrollment failed for the trustpoint.

regex: 717070: Keypair (?<keyname>\S+) in trustpoint (?<tpname>\S+) is regenerated for (?<mode>\S+) ACME certificate renewal\.$
explanation: Sucessful regeneration of the ACME keypair for the trustpoint.

regex: 717071: CRL signature validation failed\. Issuer: (?<italic_text>.+)\. Last Update: (?<italic_text_2>.+)\. Next Update: (?<italic_text_3>.+)\.$
explanation: This syslog is generated during the X509 certificate verification process when an error is detected, where the message displays a certificate revocation list (CRL) information for the failed signature validation.

regex: 718001: Internal interprocess communication queue send failure: code \[(?<error_code>\S+)\]\.$
explanation: An internal software error has occurred while attempting to enqueue a message on the VPN load balancing queue.

regex: 718004: Got unknown internal message \[(?<message_number>\S+)\]$
explanation: An internal software error occurred.

regex: 718006: Invalid load balancing state transition \[cur=(?<state_number>\S+)\]\[event=(?<event_number>\S+)\]$
explanation: A state machine error has occurred. This might indicate an internal software error.

regex: 718007: Socket open failure \[(?<failure_code>\S+)\]: (?<failure_text>\S+)$
explanation: An error occurred when the load-balancing socket tried to open. This might indicate a network problem or an internal software error.

regex: 718008: Socket bind failure \[(?<failure_code>\S+)\]: (?<failure_text>\S+)$
explanation: An error occurred when the Secure Firewall ASA tried to bind to the load-balancing socket. This might indicate a network problem or an internal software error.
An error occurred when the Secure Firewall ASA tried to send a hello response message to one of the load-balancing peers. This might indicate a network problem or an internal software error.
The Secure Firewall ASA transmitted a hello response message to a load-balancing peer.
An error occurred when the Secure Firewall ASA tried to send a hello request message to one of the load-balancing peers. This may indicate a network problem or an internal software error.
The Secure Firewall ASA transmitted a hello request message to a load-balancing peer.
The load-balancing peer is not answering a hello request message.
The load balancing director peer is not answering the hello request message.
The Secure Firewall ASA received a hello request message from the load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA received a Hello Response packet from a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA processed a timeout for an unknown peer. The message was ignored because the peer may have already been removed from the active list.
An error has occurred while attempting to send a Keepalive Request message to one of the load balancing peers. This t indicate a network problem or an internal software error.
The Secure Firewall ASA transmitted a Keepalive Request message to a load balancing peer.
An error has occurred while attempting to send a Keepalive Response message to one of the load balancing peers. This may indicate a network problem or an internal software error.
The Secure Firewall ASA transmitted a Keepalive Response message to a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA received a Keepalive Request message from a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA received a Keepalive Response message from a load balancing peer.
An error has occurred while attempting to send a Configuration Update message to one of the load balancing peers. This might indicate a network problem or an internal software error.
The Secure Firewall ASA transmitted a Configuration Update message to a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA received a Configuration Update message from a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA received an unexpected Keepalive request message from a load balancing peer.
An error has occurred while attempting to send an OOS indicator message to one of the load balancing peers. This might indicate a network problem or an internal software error.
The Secure Firewall ASA transmitted an OOS indicator message to a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA received a planned OOS message from a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA received an OOS obituary message from a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA received an OOS indicator message from a load balancing peer.
An error has occurred while attempting to send a Topology indicator message to one of the load balancing peers. This might indicate a network problem or an internal software error.
The Secure Firewall ASA sent a Topology indicator message to a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA received a Topology indicator message from a load balancing peer.

regex: 718037: Master processed (?<number_of_timeouts>\S+) timeouts$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA in the director role processed the specified number of peer timeouts.

regex: 718038: Slave processed (?<number_of_timeouts>\S+) timeouts$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA in the member role processed the specified number of peer timeouts.
The Secure Firewall ASA has detected a dead peer.

regex: 718040: Timed\-out exchange ID\[(?<exchange_id>\S+)\] not found$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA has detected a dead peer, but the exchange ID is not recognized.

regex: 718041: Timeout \[msgType=(?<type>\S+)\] processed with no callback$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA has detected a dead peer, but a call back was not used in the processing.
The Secure Firewall ASA experienced an ARP failure when attempting to contact a peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA found and is removing a duplicate peer entry.
The Secure Firewall ASA is deleting a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA has detected a load balancing peer.

regex: 718046: Create group policy \[(?<policy_name>\S+)\]$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA has created a group policy to securely communicate with the load balancing peers.

regex: 718047: Fail to create group policy \[(?<policy_name>\S+)\]$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA experienced a failure when attempting to create a group policy for securing the communication between load balancing peers.
The Secure Firewall ASA experienced a failure when attempting to establish an IPsec tunnel to a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA successfully established an IPsec tunnel to a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA experienced a failure when attempting to terminate an IPsec tunnel to a load balancing peer.
The Secure Firewall ASA successfully terminated an IPsec tunnel to a load balancing peer.

regex: 718052: Received GRAT\-ARP from duplicate control node\[(?<mac_address>\S+)\]$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA received a gratuitous ARP from a duplicate director.

regex: 718054: Detected duplicate control node\[(?<mac_address>\S+)\] and going to SLAVE$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA detected a duplicate director and is switching to member mode.

regex: 718055: Detected duplicate control node\[(?<mac_address>\S+)\] and staying MASTER$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA detected a duplicate director and is staying in member mode.

regex: 718060: Inbound socket select fail: context=(?<context_id>\S+)\.$
explanation: The socket select call returned an error and the socket cannot be read. This might indicate an internal software error.

regex: 718061: Inbound socket read fail: context=(?<context_id>\S+)\.$
explanation: The socket read failed after data was detected through the select call. This might indicate an internal software error.

regex: 718062: Inbound thread is awake \(context=(?<context_id>\S+)\)\.$
explanation: The load balancing process is awakened and begins processing.

regex: 718063: Interface (?<interface_name>\S+) is down\.$
explanation: The load balancing process found the interface down.

regex: 718064: Admin\. (?<interface>\S+) (?<interface_name>\S+) is down\.$
explanation: The load balancing process found the administrative interface down.

regex: 718068: Start VPN Load Balancing in context (?<context_id>\S+)\.$
explanation: The load balancing process has been started and initialized.

regex: 718069: Stop VPN Load Balancing in context (?<context_id>\S+)\.$
explanation: The load balancing process has been stopped.

regex: 718070: Reset VPN Load Balancing in context (?<context_id>\S+)\.$
explanation: The LB process has been reset.

regex: 718071: Terminate VPN Load Balancing in context (?<context_id>\S+)\.$
explanation: The LB process has been terminated.

regex: 718072: Becoming control node of Load Balancing in context (?<context_id>\S+)\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA has become the LB director.

regex: 718073: Becoming data node of Load Balancing in context (?<context_id>\S+)\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA has become the LB member.

regex: 718074: Fail to create access list for peer (?<context_id>\S+)\.$
explanation: ACLs are used to create secure tunnels over which the LB peers can communicate. The Secure Firewall ASA was unable to create one of these ACLs. This might indicate an addressing problem or an internal software problem.
While removing a secure tunnel, the Secure Firewall ASA detected a peer entry that did not have an associated ACL.
The Secure Firewall ASA experienced a failure when trying to create a tunnel group for securing the communication between load balancing peers.
The Secure Firewall ASA experienced a failure when attempting to delete a tunnel group for securing the communication between load balancing peers.
The Secure Firewall ASA experienced a failure when attempting to create a crypto map for securing the communication between load balancing peers.
The Secure Firewall ASA experienced a failure when attempting to delete a crypto map for securing the communication between load balancing peers.

The Secure Firewall ASA experienced a failure when attempting to create a transform set to be used in securing the communication between load balancing peers. This might indicate an internal software problem.
The Secure Firewall ASA experienced a failure when attempting to delete a transform set used in securing the communication between load balancing peers.

When cluster encryption for VPN load balancing is enabled, the VPN load balancing device creates a set of site-to-site tunnels for every other device in the load balancing cluster. For each tunnel, a set of crypto parameters (access list, crypto maps, and transform set) is created dynamically. One or more crypto parameters failed to be created or configured.
When the local VPN load balancing device is removed from the cluster, crypto parameters are removed. One or more crypto parameters failed to be deleted.
The interface does not have an IP address configured.

regex: 718088: Possible VPN LB misconfiguration\. Offending device MAC \[(?<mac_address>\S+)\]\.$
explanation: The presence of a duplicate director indicates that one of the load balancing peers may be misconfigured.

regex: 719001: Email Proxy session could not be established: session limit of (?<maximum_sessions>\S+) has been reached\.$
explanation: The incoming e-mail proxy session cannot be established because the maximum session limit has been reached.
The session has been terminated because of an error. The possible errors are failure to add a session to the session database, failure to allocate memory, and failure to write data to a channel.
The dynamic allocated session structure has been freed and set to NULL after the session terminated.
A new incoming e-mail client session has been established.
The FSM has been created for an incoming new session.

regex: 719006: Email Proxy session (?<pointer>\S+) has timed out for (?<src_ip>(?:\[[^\]]+\]|(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)|[0-9a-fA-F:.]+)) because of network congestion\.$
explanation: Network congestion is occurring, and data cannot be sent to either an e-mail client or an e-mail server. This condition starts the block timer. After the block timer is timed out, the session expires.
A matching session cannot be found in the session database. The session pointer is bad.

regex: 719010: (?<protocol>\S+) Email Proxy feature is disabled on (?<interface>\S+) (?<interface_name>\S+) \.$
explanation: The e-mail proxy feature is disabled on a specific entry point, invoked from the CLI. This is the main off switch for the user. When all protocols are turned off for all interfaces, the main shut-down routine is invoked to clean up global resources and threads.

regex: 719011: Protocol Email Proxy feature is enabled on (?<interface>\S+) (?<interface_name>\S+) \.$
explanation: The e-mail proxy feature is enabled on a specific entry point, invoked from the CLI. This is the main on switch for the user. When it is first used, the main startup routine is invoked to allocate global resources and threads. Subsequent calls only need to start listening threads for the particular protocol.

regex: 719012: Email Proxy server listening on port (?<port>\S+) for mail protocol (?<protocol>\S+) \.$
explanation: A listening channel is opened for a specific protocol on a configured port and has added it to a TCP select group.

regex: 719013: Email Proxy server closing port (?<port>\S+) for mail protocol (?<protocol>\S+) \.$
explanation: A listening channel is closed for a specific protocol on a configured port and has removed it from the TCP select group.

regex: 719014: Email Proxy is changing listen port from (?<old_port>\S+) to (?<new_port>\S+) for mail protocol (?<protocol>\S+) \.$
explanation: A change is signaled in the listening port for the specified protocol. All enabled interfaces for that port have their listening channels closed and have restarted listening on the new port. This action is invoked from the CLI.

regex: 719017: (?<webvpn>\S+) (?<user>\S+): (?<vpnuser>\S+) invalid dynamic ACL\.$
explanation: The WebVPN session is aborted because the ACL has failed to parse for this user. The ACL determines what the user restrictions are on e-mail account access. The ACL is downloaded from the AAA server. Because of this error, it is unsafe to proceed with login.

regex: 719018: (?<webvpn>\S+) (?<user>\S+): (?<vpnuser>\S+) ACL ID (?<acl_id>\S+) not found$
explanation: The ACL cannot be found at the local maintained ACL list. The ACL determines what the user restrictions are on e-mail account access. The ACL is configured locally. Because of this error, you cannot be authorized to proceed.

regex: 719019: (?<webvpn>\S+) (?<user>\S+): (?<vpnuser>\S+) authorization failed\.$
explanation: The ACL determines what the user restrictions are on e-mail account access. The user cannot access the e-mail account because the authorization check fails.

regex: 719020: (?<webvpn>\S+) (?<user>\S+) (?<vpnuser>\S+) authorization completed successfully\.$
explanation: The ACL determines what the user restrictions are on e-mail account access. The user is authorized to access the e-mail account.

regex: 719021: (?<webvpn>\S+) (?<user>\S+): (?<vpnuser>\S+) is not checked against ACL\.$
explanation: The ACL determines what the user restrictions are on e-mail account access. The authorization checking using the ACL is not enabled.

regex: 719022: (?<webvpn>\S+) (?<user>\S+) (?<vpnuser>\S+) has been authenticated\.$
explanation: The username is authenticated by the AAA server.

regex: 719023: (?<webvpn>\S+) (?<user>\S+) (?<vpnuser>\S+) has not been successfully authenticated\. Access denied\.$
explanation: The username is denied by the AAA server. The session will be aborted. The user is not allowed to access the e-mail account.

The Piggyback authentication is using an established WebVPN session to verify the username and IP address matching in the WebVPN session database. This is based on the assumption that the WebVPN session and e-mail proxy session are initiated by the same user, and a WebVPN session is already established. Because the authentication has failed, the session will be aborted. The user is not allowed to access the e-mail account.

regex: 719025: Email Proxy DNS name resolution failed for (?<hostname>\S+) \.$
explanation: The hostname cannot be resolved with the IP address because it is not valid, or no DNS server is available.
The hostname has successfully been resolved with the IP address.

regex: 720001: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to initialize with Chunk Manager\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem fails to initialize with the memory buffer management subsystem. A system-wide problem has occurred, and the VPN failover subsystem cannot be started.

regex: 720002: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Starting VPN Stateful Failover Subsystem\.\.\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem is starting and booting up.

regex: 720003: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Initialization of VPN Stateful Failover Component completed successfully$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem initialization is completed at boot time.

regex: 720004: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN failover main thread started\.$
explanation: The VPN failover main processing thread is started at boot time.

regex: 720005: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN failover timer thread started\.$
explanation: The VPN failover timer processing thread is started at boot time.

regex: 720006: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN failover sync thread started\.$
explanation: The VPN failover bulk synchronization processing thread is started at boot time.

regex: 720007: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to allocate chunk from Chunk Manager\.$
explanation: The set of preallocated memory buffers is running out. The Secure Firewall ASA has a resource issue. The Secure Firewall ASA may be under heavy load when too many messages are being processed.

regex: 720008: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to register to High Availability Framework\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem failed to register to the core failover subsystem. The VPN failover subsystem cannot be started, which may be caused by initialization problems of other subsystems.

regex: 720009: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to create version control block\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem failed to create a version control block. This step is required for the VPN failover subsystem to find out the backward compatible firmware versions for the current release. The VPN failover subsystem cannot be started, which may be caused by initialization problems of other subsystems.

regex: 720010: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN failover client is being disabled$
explanation: An operator enabled failover without defining a failover key. In order to use a VPN failover, a failover key must be defined.

regex: 720011: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to allocate memory$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem cannot allocate a memory buffer, which indicates a system-wide resource problem. The Secure Firewall ASA may be under heavy load.

regex: 720012: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to update IPsec failover runtime data on the standby unit\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem cannot update IPsec-related runtime data because the corresponding IPsec tunnel has been deleted on the standby unit.

regex: 720013: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to insert certificate in trustpoint (?<trustpoint_name>\S+)$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem tried to insert a certificate in the trustpoint.

regex: 720016: \(VPN\-unit\) Failed to initialize default timer (?<index>\S+) \.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem failed to initialize the given timer event. The VPN failover subsystem cannot be started at boot time.

regex: 720017: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to update LB runtime data$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem failed to update the VPN load balancing runtime data.

regex: 720018: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to get a buffer from the underlying core high availability subsystem\. Error code code\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA may be under heavy load. The VPN failover subsystem failed to obtain a failover buffer.

regex: 720019: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to update cTCP statistics\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem failed to update the IPsec/cTCP-related statistics.

regex: 720020: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to send type timer message\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem failed to send a periodic timer message to the standby unit.

regex: 720021: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) HA non\-block send failed for peer msg (?<message_number>\S+) \. HA error (?<code>\S+) \.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem failed to send a nonblock message. This is a temporary condition caused by the Secure Firewall ASA being under load or out of resources.

regex: 720022: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Cannot find trustpoint (?<trustpoint>\S+)$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to look up a trustpoint by name.

regex: 720023: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) HA status callback: Peer is (?<not>\S+) present\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem is notified by the core failover subsystem when the local Secure Firewall ASA detected that a peer is available or becomes unavailable.

regex: 720024: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) HA status callback: Control channel is (?<status>\S+) \.$
explanation: The failover control channel is either up or down. The failover control channel is defined by the failover link and show failover commands, which indicate whether the failover link channel is up or down.

regex: 720025: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) HA status callback: Data channel is (?<status>\S+) \.$
explanation: The failover data channel is up or down.

regex: 720026: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) HA status callback: Current progression is being aborted\.$
explanation: An operator or other external condition has occurred and has caused the current failover progression to abort before the failover peer agrees on the role (either active or standby). For example, when the failover active command is entered on the standby unit during the negotiation, or when the active unit is being rebooted.

regex: 720027: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) HA status callback: My state (?<state>\S+) \.$
explanation: The state of the local failover device is changed.

regex: 720028: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) HA status callback: Peer state (?<state>\S+) \.$
explanation: The current state of the failover peer is reported.

regex: 720029: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) HA status callback: Start VPN bulk sync state\.$
explanation: The active unit is ready to send all the state information to the standby unit.

regex: 720030: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) HA status callback: Stop bulk sync state\.$
explanation: The active unit finished sending all the state information to the standby unit.

regex: 720031: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) HA status callback: Invalid event received\. event=(?<event_id>\S+) \.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem received an invalid callback event from the underlying failover subsystem.

regex: 720033: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to queue add to message queue\.$
explanation: System resources may be running low. An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to queue an internal message. This may be a temporary condition indicating that the Secure Firewall ASA is under heavy load, and the VPN failover subsystem cannot allocate resource to handle incoming traffic.

regex: 720034: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Invalid type \((?<type>\S+) \) for message handler\.$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to process an invalid message type.

regex: 720035: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Fail to look up CTCP flow handle$
explanation: The cTCP flow may be deleted on the standby unit before the VPN failover subsystem tries to do a lookup.

regex: 720036: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to process state update message from the active peer\.$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to process a state update message received by the standby unit.

regex: 720038: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Corrupted message from active unit\.$
explanation: The standby unit received a corrupted message from the active unit. Messages from the active unit are corrupted, which may be caused by incompatible firmware running between the active and standby units. The local unit has become the active unit of the failover pair.

regex: 720039: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN failover client is transitioning to active state$
explanation: The local unit has become the active unit of the failover pair.

regex: 720040: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN failover client is transitioning to standby state\.$
explanation: The local unit has become the standby unit of the failover pair.

regex: 720041: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Sending (?<type>\S+) message (?<id>\S+) to standby unit$
explanation: A message has been sent from the active unit to the standby unit.

regex: 720042: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Receiving (?<type>\S+) message (?<id>\S+) from active unit$
explanation: A message has been received from the active unit by the standby unit.

regex: 720043: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to send (?<type>\S+) message (?<id>\S+) to standby unit$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to send a message from the active unit to the standby unit. The error may be caused by message 720018, in which the core failover subsystem runs out of failover buffer or the failover LAN link is down.

regex: 720044: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to receive message from active unit$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to receive a message on the standby unit. The error may be caused by a corrupted message or an inadequate amount of memory allocated for storing the incoming message.

regex: 720045: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Start bulk syncing of state information on standby unit\.$
explanation: The standby unit has been notified to start receiving bulk synchronization information from the active unit.

regex: 720046: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) End bulk syncing of state information on standby unit$
explanation: The standby unit has been notified that bulk synchronization from the active unit is completed.

An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to synchronize a node secret file for the SDI server on the standby unit. The SDI node secret file is stored in flash. The error may indicate that the flash file system is full or corrupted.

regex: 720050: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to remove timer\. ID = (?<id>\S+) \.$
explanation: A timer cannot be removed from the timer processing thread.

regex: 720051: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to add new SDI node secret file for server (?<id>\S+) on the standby unit\.$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to add a node secret file for the SDI server on the standby unit. The SDI node secret file is stored in flash. The error may indicate that the flash file system is full or corrupted.

regex: 720052: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to delete SDI node secret file for server (?<id>\S+) on the standby unit\.$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to delete a node secret file on the active unit. The node secret file being deleted may not exist in the flash file system, or there was problem reading the flash file system.

regex: 720055: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN Stateful failover can only be run in single/non\-transparent mode\.$
explanation: The VPN subsystem does not start unless it is running in single (nontransparent) mode.

regex: 720056: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN Stateful failover Message Thread is being disabled\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem main message processing thread is disabled when you have tried to enable failover, but a failover key is not defined. A failover key is required for VPN failover.

regex: 720057: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN Stateful failover Message Thread is enabled\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem main message processing thread is enabled when failover is enabled and a failover key is defined.

regex: 720058: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN Stateful failover Timer Thread is disabled\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem main timer processing thread is disabled when the failover key is not defined and failover is enabled.

regex: 720059: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN Stateful failover Timer Thread is enabled\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem main timer processing thread is enabled when the failover key is defined and failover is enabled.

regex: 720060: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN Stateful failover Sync Thread is disabled\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem main bulk synchronization processing thread is disabled when failover is enabled, but the failover key is not defined.

regex: 720061: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) VPN Stateful failover Sync Thread is enabled\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem main bulk synchronization processing thread is enabled when failover is enabled and the failover key is defined.

regex: 720062: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Active unit started bulk sync of state information to standby unit\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem active unit has started bulk synchronization of state information to the standby unit.

regex: 720063: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Active unit completed bulk sync of state information to standby\.$
explanation: The VPN failover subsystem active unit has completed bulk synchronization of state information to the standby unit.

regex: 720066: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to activate IKE database\.$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to activate the IKE security association database while the standby unit was transitioning to the active state. There may be resource-related issues on the standby unit that prevent the IKE security association database from activating.

regex: 720067: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to deactivate IKE database\.$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to deactivate the IKE security association database while the active unit was transitioning to the standby state. There may be resource-related issues on the active unit that prevent the IKE security association database from deactivating.

regex: 720068: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to parse peer message\.$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to parse a peer message received on the standby unit. The peer message received on the standby unit cannot be parsed.

regex: 720069: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to activate cTCP database\.$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to activate the cTCP database while the standby unit was transitioning to the active state. There may be resource-related issues on the standby unit that prevent the cTCP database from activating.

regex: 720070: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to deactivate cTCP database\.$
explanation: An error occurred when the VPN failover subsystem tried to deactivate the cTCP database while the active unit was transitioning to the standby state. There may be resource-related issues on the active unit that prevent the cTCP database from deactivating.

regex: 720071: \(VPN\-(?<unit>\S+) \) Failed to update cTCP dynamic data\.$
explanation: An error occurred while the VPN failover subsystem tried to update cTCP dynamic data.

regex: 720073: VPN Session failed to replicate \- ACL (?<acl_name>\S+) not found$
explanation: When replicating VPN sessions to the standby unit, the standby unit failed to find the associated filter ACL.

regex: 721001: (?<device>\S+) (?<webvpn>\S+) Failover (?<subsystem>\S+) started successfully\.$
explanation: The WebVPN failover subsystem in the current failover unit, either primary or secondary, has been started successfully.

regex: 721004: (?<device>\S+) Create access list (?<list_name>\S+) on standby unit\.$
explanation: A WebVPN-specific access list is replicated from the active unit to the standby unit. A successful installation of the WebVPN access list on the standby unit has occurred.

regex: 721005: (?<device>\S+) Fail to create access list (?<list_name>\S+) on standby unit\.$
explanation: When a WebVPN-specific access list is installed on the active unit, a copy is installed on the standby unit. The access list failed to be installed on the standby unit. The access list may have existed on the standby unit already.

regex: 721006: (?<device>\S+) Update access list (?<list_name>\S+) on standby unit\.$
explanation: The content of the access list has been updated on the standby unit.

regex: 721007: (?<device>\S+) Fail to update access list (?<list_name>\S+) on standby unit\.$
explanation: An error occurred while the standby unit tried to update a WebVPN-specific access list. The access list cannot be located on the standby unit.

regex: 721008: (?<device>\S+) Delete access list (?<list_name>\S+) on standby unit\.$
explanation: When a WebVPN-specific access list is removed from the active unit, a message is sent to the standby unit requesting that the same access list be removed. As a result, a WebVPN-specific access list has been removed from the standby unit.

regex: 721009: (?<device>\S+) Fail to delete access list (?<list_name>\S+) on standby unit\.$
explanation: When a WebVPN-specific access list is removed on the active unit, a message is sent to the standby unit requesting the same access list be removed. An error condition occurred when an attempt was made to remove the corresponding access list on the standby unit. The access list did not exist on the standby unit.

regex: 721010: (?<device>\S+) Add access list (?<list_name>\S+) on standby unit\.$
explanation: When an access list rule is added to the active unit, the same rule is added on the standby unit. A new access list rule was added successfully on the standby unit.

regex: 721011: (?<device>\S+) Fail to add access list (?<list_name>\S+) on standby unit\.$
explanation: When an access list rule is added to the active unit, an attempt is made to add the same access list rule to the standby unit. An error occurred when an attempt is made to add a new access list rule to the standby unit. The same access list rule may exist on the standby unit.

regex: 721012: (?<device>\S+) Enable APCF XML file (?<file_name>\S+) on the standby unit\.$
explanation: When an APCF XML file is installed on the active unit, an attempt is made to install the same file on the standby unit. An APCF XML file was installed successfully on the standby unit. Use the dir command on the standby unit to show that the XML file exists in the flash file system.

regex: 721013: (?<device>\S+) Fail to enable APCF XML file (?<file_name>\S+) on the standby unit\.$
explanation: When an APCF XML file is installed on the active unit, an attempt is made to install the same file on the standby unit. An APCF XML file failed to install on the standby unit.

regex: 721014: (?<device>\S+) Disable APCF XML file (?<file_name>\S+) on the standby unit\.$
explanation: When an APCF XML file is removed on the active unit, an attempt is made to remove the same file on the standby unit. An APCF XML file was removed from the standby unit successfully.

regex: 721015: (?<device>\S+) Fail to disable APCF XML file (?<file_name>\S+) on the standby unit\.$
explanation: When an APCF XML file is removed on the active unit, an attempt is made to remove the same file on the standby unit. An error occurred when an attempt was made to remove an APCF XML file from the standby unit. The file may not be installed on the standby unit.

regex: 721016: (?<device>\S+) (?<webvpn>\S+) session for client (?<user>\S+) has been created\.$
explanation: A remote WebVPN user has logged in successfully and the login information has been installed on the standby unit.

regex: 721017: (?<device>\S+) \.Fail to create (?<webvpn>\S+) session for client (?<user>\S+)\.$
explanation: When a WebVPN user logs in to the active unit, the login information is replicated to the standby unit. An error occurred while replicating the login information to the standby unit.

regex: 721018: (?<device>\S+) (?<webvpn>\S+) session for client (?<user>\S+) has been deleted\.$
explanation: When a WebVPN user logs out on the active unit, a logout message is sent to the standby unit to remove the user session from the standby unit. A WebVPN user record was removed from the standby unit successfully.

regex: 721019: (?<device>\S+) \.Fail to delete (?<webvpn>\S+) session for client (?<user>\S+)\.$
explanation: When a WebVPN user logs out on the active unit, a logout message is sent to the standby unit to remove the user session from the standby unit. An error occurred when an attempt was made to remove a WebVPN user record from the standby unit.
There is not enough memory to perform the action.
There is not enough memory to perform the action.

regex: 722005: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>(?:\[[^\]]+\]|(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)|[0-9a-fA-F:.]+)) Unable to update session information for SVC connection\.$
explanation: There is not enough memory to perform the action.
An invalid address was assigned to the user.
The SVC issued a message.
The SVC issued a message.
The SVC issued a message.
The SVC issued a message.
The SVC issued a message.
The SVC sent an invalid frame type to the device, which might be caused by an SVC version incompatibility.
The expected amount of data was not available from the SVC, which might be caused by an SVC version incompatibility.
The expected amount of data was not available from the SVC, which might be caused by an SVC version incompatibility.

regex: 722020: (?<tunnelgroup>\S+) (?<tunnel_group>\S+) (?<grouppolicy>\S+) (?<group_policy>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>(?:\[[^\]]+\]|(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)|[0-9a-fA-F:.]+)) No address available for SVC connection$
explanation: Address assignment failed for the AnyConnect session. No IP addresses are available.

regex: 722021: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>(?:\[[^\]]+\]|(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)|[0-9a-fA-F:.]+)) Unable to start compression due to lack of memory resources$
explanation: There is not enough memory to perform the action.
The TCP or UDP connection was established with or without compression.
The SVC terminated either with or without compression.
A compression error occurred. The SVC and the ASA corrected it.
A decompression error occurred. The SVC and the ASA corrected it.
An unused SVC connection was closed.
A large packet was received from the client.

regex: 722036: *Group +(?:<\s*)?(?<group>[^\>]+)(?:\s*>)?\s+User\s+(?:<\s*)?(?<user>[^\>\s]+)(?:\s*>)?\s+IP\s+(?:<\s*)?(?<dest_ip>[^\>\s]+)(?:\s*>)?\s+Transmitting\s+large\s+packet\s+(?<bytes_out>\d+)\s*\(\s*threshold\s*(?<threshold>\d+)\s*\)
explanation: A large packet was sent to the client. The source of the packet may not be aware of the MTU of the client. This could also be due to compression of non-compressible data.
An SVC connection was terminated for the given reason. This behavior may be normal, or you may be having trouble connecting.

regex: 722038: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<name>\S+) IP (?<user>\S+) SVC terminating session: (?<reason>\S+)\.$
explanation: An SVC session was terminated for the given reason. This behavior may be normal, or you may be having trouble connecting.

regex: 722039: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>\S+) SVC 'vpn\-filter (?<acl>\S+)' is an IPv6 ACL; ACL not applied\.$
explanation: The type of ACL to be applied is incorrect. An IPv6 ACL has been configured as an IPv4 ACL through the vpn-filter command.

regex: 722040: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>\S+) SVC 'ipv6\-vpn\-filter (?<acl>\S+)' is an IPv4 ACL; ACL not applied\.$
explanation: The type of ACL to be applied is incorrect. An IPv4 ACL has been configured as an IPv6 ACL through the ipv6-vpn-filter command.
An IPv6 address was not available for assignment to the remote SVC client.

regex: 722042: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>\S+) Invalid (?<cisco>\S+) SSL Tunneling Protocol version$
explanation: An invalid SVC or AnyConnect client is trying to connect.

regex: 722043: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>\S+) DTLS disabled: unable to negotiate cipher$
explanation: The DTLS (UDP transport) cannot be established. The SSL encryption configuration was probably changed.

regex: 722044: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>\S+) Unable to request IPv(?<ver>\S+) address for SSL tunnel$
explanation: An IP address cannot be requested because of low memory on the Secure Firewall ASA.

regex: 722046: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>\S+) Session terminated: Unable to establish tunnel$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA cannot set up connection parameters. This is a defect in the Secure Firewall ASA software.

regex: 722047: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>\S+) Tunnel terminated: SVC not enabled or invalid SVC image on the (?<asa>\S+)$
explanation: The user logged in via the web browser and tried to start the SVC or AnyConnect client. The SVC service is not enabled globally, or the SVC image is invalid or corrupted. The tunnel connection has been terminated, but the clientless connection remains.

regex: 722048: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>\S+) Tunnel terminated: SVC not enabled for the (?<user_2>\S+)$
explanation: The user logged in via the web browser, and tried to start the SVC or AnyConnect client. The SVC service is not enabled for this user. The tunnel connection has been terminated, but the clientless connection remains.

regex: 722049: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>\S+) Session terminated: SVC not enabled or invalid SVC image on the (?<asa>\S+)$
explanation: The user logged in via the AnyConnect client. The SVC service is not enabled globally, or the SVC image is invalid or corrupted. The session connection has been terminated.

regex: 722050: Group (?<group>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>\S+) Session terminated: SVC not enabled for the (?<user_2>\S+)$
explanation: The user logged in through the AnyConnect client. The SVC service is not enabled for this user. The session connection has been terminated.
The specified address has been assigned to the given user.

regex: 722054: Group (?<group_policy>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<remote_ip>\S+) SVC terminating connection: Failed to install Redirect URL: (?<redirect_url>\S+) Redirect ACL: (?<non_exist>\S+) for (?<assigned_ip>(?:\[[^\]]+\]|(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)|[0-9a-fA-F:.]+))\.$
explanation: An error occurred for an AnyConnect VPN connection when a redirect URL was installed, and the ACL was received from the ISE, but the redirect ACL does not exist on the Secure Firewall ASA.

regex: 722056: Unsupported (?<anyconnect>\S+) client connection rejected from ip address\. Client info: (?<user>\S+)\-agent string\. Reason: reason$
explanation: This syslog indicates that an AnyConnect client connection is rejected. The reason for this is provided in the syslog along with the client information.

regex: 722057: Group (?<italic_text>.+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<italic_text_2>.+) SVC terminating connection: Failed to bind SGT (?<tag>\S+) with assigned IP: (?<italic_text_3>.+)\.$
explanation: When the device fails to bind a Security Group Tag (SGT) to the assigned IP address during remote access VPN authentication, this message is generated. The syslog message provides information that helps to identify when an SGT binding error occurs, along with specific user, group, and IP information, making it much easier to diagnose and resolve related issues.
The Citrix connection is up.
The Citrix connection is down.

regex: 723003: No memory for (?<webvpn>\S+) Citrix ICA connection (?<connection>\S+)\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA is running out of memory. The Citrix connection was rejected.

regex: 723004: (?<webvpn>\S+) Citrix encountered bad flow control (?<flow>\S+)\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA encountered an internal flow control mismatch, which can be caused by massive data flow, such as might occur during stress testing or with a high volume of ICA connections.

regex: 723005: No channel to set up (?<webvpn>\S+) Citrix ICA connection\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA was unable to create a new channel for Citrix.

regex: 723006: (?<webvpn>\S+) Citrix SOCKS errors\.$
explanation: An internal Citrix SOCKS error has occurred on the Secure Firewall ASA.

regex: 723007: (?<webvpn>\S+) Citrix ICA connection (?<connection>\S+) list is broken\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA internal Citrix connection list is broken.

regex: 723008: (?<webvpn>\S+) Citrix ICA SOCKS Server (?<server>\S+) is invalid\.$
explanation: An attempt was made to access a Citrix Socks server that does not exist.

regex: 723009: Group (?<group_name>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>(?:\[[^\]]+\]|(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)|[0-9a-fA-F:.]+)) (?<webvpn>\S+) Citrix received data on invalid connection (?<connection>\S+)\.$
explanation: Data was received on a Citrix connection that does not exist.

An abort was received on a nonexistent Citrix connection, which can be caused by massive data flow (such as stress testing) or a high volume of ICA connections, especially during network delay or packet loss.

regex: 723011: Group (?<group_name>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>(?:\[[^\]]+\]|(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)|[0-9a-fA-F:.]+)) (?<webvpn>\S+) Citrix received bad SOCKS (?<socks>\S+) message length (?<msg_length>\S+)\. Expected length is (?<exp_msg_length>\S+)\.$
explanation: The Citrix SOCKS message length is incorrect.
The Citrix SOCKS message format is incorrect.

regex: 723013: (?<webvpn>\S+) Citrix encountered invalid connection (?<connection>\S+) during periodic timeout\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA internal Citrix timer has expired, and the Citrix connection is invalid.

regex: 723014: Group (?<group_name>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>(?:\[[^\]]+\]|(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)|[0-9a-fA-F:.]+)) (?<webvpn>\S+) Citrix TCP connection (?<connection>\S+) to server (?<server>\S+) on channel (?<channel>\S+) initiated\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA internal Citrix Secure Gateway is connected to the Citrix server.

regex: 724001: Group (?<group_name>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>(?:\[[^\]]+\]|(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)|[0-9a-fA-F:.]+)) (?<webvpn>\S+) session not allowed\. Unable to determine if Secure Desktop software was running on the client's workstation\.$
explanation: The session was not allowed because an error occurred during processing of the CSD Host Integrity Check results on the Secure Firewall ASA.

regex: 724002: Group (?<group_name>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>(?:\[[^\]]+\]|(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d\d|[1-9]?\d)|[0-9a-fA-F:.]+)) (?<webvpn>\S+) session not terminated\. Secure Desktop was not running on the client's workstation\.$
explanation: CSD is not running on the client machine.

regex: 725001:\s*(?<action>Starting)\s+SSL\s+handshake\s+with\s+(?<peer_type>\S+)\s+(?<src_interface>[^:\s]+):(?<src_ip>\S+)\/(?<src_port>\d+)(?: to (?<dest_ip>\S+)\/(?<dest_port>\d+))?\s+for\s+(?<protocol_version>\S+)\s+session\.?
explanation: The SSL handshake has started with the remote device, which can be a client or server.

regex: 725004: Device requesting certificate from SSL client (?<peer_type>\S+):(?<interface>\S+)/(?<src_ip>\S+) to (?<src_port>\S+)/(?<dst_ip>\S+) for authentication$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA has requested a client certificate for authentication.

regex: 725005: SSL server (?<peer_type>\S+):(?<interface>\S+)/(?<src_ip>\S+) to (?<src_port>\S+)/(?<dst_ip>\S+) requesting our device certificate for authentication$
explanation: The server has requested the certificate of the Secure Firewall ASA for authentication.
The number of ciphers proposed to the SSL server are listed.

regex: 725010: *Device +supports +the +following +(?<supported_ciphers>\d+)
explanation: The number of ciphers supported by the Secure Firewall ASA for an SSL session are listed.

regex: 725011:?\s*Cipher\s*\[\s*(?<order>\d+) *\] *: *(?<cipher_name>.+)
explanation: Always following messages 725008, 725009, and 725010, this message indicates the cipher name and its order of preference.

regex: 725013: SSL server (?<interface>\S+):(?<src_ip>\S+)/(?<src_port>\S+) to (?<dst_ip>\S+)/(?<dst_port>\S+) chooses cipher (?<cipher>\S+)$
explanation: The cipher that was chosen by the server for the SSL session is identified.

regex: 725015: Error verifying client certificate\. Public key size in client certificate \((?<actual_key_size>\S+) bits\) exceeds the maximum supported key size of (?<ideal_key_size>\S+) bits$
explanation: The verification of an SSL client certificate failed because of an unsupported (large) key size.

regex: 725021: Device preferring (?<cipher_suite>\S+) cipher\(s\)\. Connection info: (?<interface>\S+) :(?<src_ip>\S+) /(?<src_port>\S+) to (?<dst_ip>\S+) /(?<dst_port>\S+)$
explanation: The cipher suites being preferred when negotiating the handshake is listed in this message.

regex: 725022: Device skipping cipher : (?<cipher>\S+) \- (?<reason>\S+)\. Connection info: (?<interface>\S+) :(?<src_ip>\S+) /(?<src_port>\S+) to (?<dst_ip>\S+) /(?<dst_port>\S+)$
explanation: This syslog displays the reason for skipping a particular cipher in a list of cipher suites when negotiating the handshake.

regex: 725025: SSL Pre\-auth connection rate limit hit (?<s>\S+) watermark$
explanation: When the device reaches the rate-limit threshold for the number of pre-authenticated SSL connections. This message appears when the number of pre-authenticated SSL connections is high (90% of the limit) or when it is low (70% of the limit). The syslog is rate-limited to one syslog for every 10 seconds. In this message, s denotes high or low of the threshold limit.
An IM inspection was performed on an IM message and the specified criteria were satisfied. The configured action is taken.

regex: 730001: Group <(?<groupname>\S+)> User <(?<user>\S+)> IP <(?<ipaddr>\S+)> VLAN Mapping to VLAN <(?<vlanid>\S+)>\.$
explanation: VLAN mapping succeeded.

regex: 730002: Group <(?<groupname>\S+)> User <(?<user>\S+)> IP <(?<ipaddr>\S+)> VLAN Mapping to VLAN <(?<vlanid>\S+)> failed\.$
explanation: VLAN mapping failed.

regex: 730003: IP (?<ipaddr>\S+) egress VLAN ID is set to (?<vlanid>\S+)\.$
explanation: ASA receives an SNMP set message from NACApp to set the new VLAN ID for the session.

regex: 730004: Group (?<groupname>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ipaddr>\S+) VLAN ID (?<vlanid>\S+) from AAA ignored\.$
explanation: The VLAN ID received from AAA is different from the current one in use, and it is ignored for the current session.

regex: 730005: Group (?<dfltgrppolicy>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ip>\S+) VLAN ID (?<vlan_id>\S+) from AAA is invalid\.$
explanation: A VLAN mapping error has occurred. A VLAN may be out of range, unassigned to any interfaces, or assigned to multiple interfaces.

regex: 730007: Group (?<groupname>\S+) User (?<user>\S+) IP (?<ipaddr>\S+) changed VLAN to (?<vlan>\S+) ID (?<vlanid>\S+)\.$
explanation: NACApp (Cisco NAC appliance) posture assessment is done with the session, the VLAN is changed from AUTH VLAN to a new VLAN.

regex: 730010: Group (?<groupname>\S+) User (?<ph_1>\S+) IP (?<ipaddr>\S+) VLAN Mapping is enabled on VLAN (?<vlanid>\S+)\.$
explanation: VLAN mapping is enabled in the session.

regex: 733102: Threat\-detection adds host (?<host>\S+) to shun list$
explanation: A host has been shunned by the threat detection engine. When the threat-detection scanning-threat shun command is configured, the attacking hosts will be shunned by the threat detection engine.

regex: 733103: Threat\-detection removes host (?<host>\S+) from shun list$
explanation: A host has been shunned by the threat detection engine. When you use the clear-threat-detection shun command, the specified host will be removed from the shunned list.

regex: 733104: TCP Intercept SYN flood attack detected to (?<host_ip>\S+)/(?<host_port>\S+) \((?<real_ip>\S+)/(?<real_port>\d+)\)\. Average rate of (?<avg_rate>\S+) SYNs/sec exceeded the threshold of (?<threshold_rate>\S+)\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA is under Syn flood attack and protected by the TCP intercept mechanism, if the average rate for intercepted attacks exceeds the configured threshold. The message is showing which server is under attack and where the attacks are coming from.

regex: 733105: TCP Intercept SYN flood attack detected to (?<host_ip>\S+)/(?<host_port>\S+) \((?<real_ip>\S+)/(?<real_port>\d+)\)\. Burst rate of (?<burst_rate>\S+) SYNs/sec exceeded the threshold of (?<threshold_rate>\S+)\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA is under Syn flood attack and protected by the TCP intercept mechanism, if the burst rate for intercepted attacks exceeds the configured threshold. The message is showing which server is under attack and where the attacks are coming from.

regex: 734004: DAP: Processing error: Code (?<internal>\S+)$
explanation: A DAP processing error occurred.

regex: 735001: Cooling Fan (?<var1>\S+): OK$
explanation: A cooling fan has been restored to normal operation.

regex: 735002: Cooling Fan (?<var1>\S+): Failure Detected$
explanation: A cooling fan has failed.

regex: 735003: Power Supply (?<var1>\S+): OK$
explanation: A power supply has been restored to normal operation.

regex: 735004: Power Supply (?<var1>\S+): Failure Detected$
explanation: AC power has been lost, or the power supply has failed.

regex: 735011: Power Supply (?<var1>\S+): Fan OK$
explanation: The power supply fan has returned to a working operating state.

regex: 735012: Power Supply (?<var1>\S+): Fan Failure Detected$
explanation: The power supply fan has failed.

regex: 735013: Voltage Channel (?<var1>\S+): Voltage OK$
explanation: A voltage channel has returned to a normal operating level.

regex: 735014: Voltage Channel (?<var1>\S+): Voltage Critical$
explanation: A voltage channel has changed to a critical level.

regex: 735022: CPU(?<num>\S+) is running beyond the max thermal operating temperature and the device will be shutting down immediately to prevent permanent damage to the CPU$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA has detected a CPU running beyond the maximum thermal operating temperature, and will shut down immediately after detection.

regex: 735023: (?<device>\S+) was previously shutdown due to the CPU complex running beyond the max thermal operating temperature\. The chassis needs to be inspected immediately for ventilation issues$
explanation: At boot time, the Secure Firewall ASA detected a shutdown that occurred because a CPU was running beyond the maximum safe operating temperature. Using the show environment command will indicate that this event has occurred.

regex: 735024: CPU(?<var1>\S+) Voltage Regulator is running beyond the max thermal operating temperature and the device will be shutting down immediately\. The chassis and CPU need to be inspected immediately for ventilation issues$
explanation: The IO hub temperature has returned to the normal operating temperature.

regex: 735025: (?<var1>\S+) was previously shutdown due to a CPU Voltage Regulator running beyond the max thermal operating temperature\. The chassis and CPU need to be inspected immediately for ventilation issues$
explanation: The IO hub temperature has a critical temperature.

regex: 735027: CPU (?<cpu_num>\S+) Voltage Regulator is running beyond the max thermal operating temperature and the device will be shutting down immediately\. The chassis and CPU need to be inspected immediately for ventilation issues\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA has detected a CPU voltage regulator running beyond the maximum thermal operating temperature, and shuts down immediately after detection.

regex: 741000: Coredump filesystem image created on (?<variable_1>\S+) \- size (?<variable_2>\S+) MB$
explanation: A core dump file system was successfully created. The file system is used to manage core dumps by capping the amount of disk space that core dumps may use.

regex: 741001: Coredump filesystem image on (?<variable>\S+) \- resized from (?<variable_2>\S+) MB to (?<variable_3>\S+) MB$
explanation: The core dump file system has been successfully resized.

regex: 741002: Coredump log and filesystem contents cleared on (?<variable_1>\S+)$
explanation: All core dumps have been deleted from the core dump file system, and the core dump log has been cleared. The core dump file system and coredump log are always synchronized with each other.

regex: 741003: Coredump filesystem and it's contents removed on (?<variable_1>\S+)$
explanation: The core dump file system and its contents have been removed, and the core dump feature has been disabled.

regex: 741005: Coredump operation '(?<variable_1>\S+)' failed with error (?<variable_2_variable_3>\S+)$
explanation: An error occurred during the performance of a core dump-related operation.

regex: 742005: cipher text (?<enc_pass>\S+) is not compatible with the configured master key or the cipher text has been tampered$
explanation: An attempt to decrypt a password failed. The password may have been encrypted using a primary key that is different from the current primary key, or the encrypted password has been changed from its original form.

regex: 742008: password (?<enc_pass>\S+) decryption failed due to decoding error$
explanation: Password decryption failed because of decoding errors, which may occur if the encrypted password has been modified after being encrypted.

regex: 742010: encrypted password (?<enc_pass>\S+) is not well formed$
explanation: The encrypted password provided in the command is not well formed. The password may not be a valid, encrypted password, or it may have been modified since it was encrypted.

regex: 743000: The PCI device with vendor ID: (?<vendor_id>\S+) device ID: (?<device_id>\S+) located at bus:device\.function \(hex\) (?<bus_num>\S+):(?<dev_num>\S+)\.(?<func_num>\S+) has a link (?<link_attr_name>\S+) of (?<actual_link_attr_val>\S+) when it should have a link (?<link_attr_name_2>\S+) of (?<expected_link_attr_val>\S+)$
explanation: A PCI device in the system is not configured correctly, which may result in the system not performing at its optimum level.

regex: 743004: System is not fully operational \- The PCI device with vendor ID: (?<vendor_id>\S+) \((?<vendor_name>\S+)\) device ID: (?<device_id>\S+) \((?<device_name>\S+)\) could not be found in the system\.$
explanation: A PCI device in the system that is needed for it to be fully operational was not found.

regex: 743010: EOBC RPC server failed to start for client module (?<client_name>\S+)\.$
explanation: The service failed to start for a particular client of the EOBC RPC service on the server.

regex: 746001: (?<user_2>\S+)\-identity: (?<ph_0___to_ip_address_databases>\S+) started$
explanation: A database (user groups, hostnames, or IP addresses) download has started.

regex: 746002: (?<user_2>\S+)\-identity: (?<ph_0___to_ip_address_databases>\S+) complete$
explanation: A database (user groups, hostnames, or IP addresses) download has completed.

regex: 746003: (?<user_2>\S+)\-identity: (?<ph_0___to_ip_address_databases>\S+) failed \- (?<reason>\S+)$
explanation: A database (user groups, hostnames, or IP addresses) download has failed because of a timeout.

regex: 746004: (?<user>\S+)\-identity: Total number of activated (?<user_2>\S+) groups exceeds the maximum number of (?<max_groups>\S+) groups for this platform$
explanation: The total number of activated user groups exceeds the maximum number of 256 user groups for this platform.

regex: 746005: (?<user>\S+)\-identity: The AD Agent (?<ad_agent_ip_address>\S+) cannot be reached \- (?<reason>\S+)(?<action>\S+)$
explanation: The ASA cannot reach the AD agent. There has been no response from the AD agent, or the RADIUS registration failed because the buffer was too small.

regex: 746007: (?<user_2>\S+)\-identity: (?<netbios>\S+) response failed from User (?<user>\S+) at (?<user_ip>\S+)$
explanation: No NetBIOS response was received for the number of retries made.

regex: 746008: (?<user>\S+)\-identity: (?<netbios>\S+) Logout Probe Process started$
explanation: The NetBIOS process has started.

regex: 746009: (?<user>\S+)\-identity: (?<netbios>\S+) Logout Probe Process stopped$
explanation: The NetBIOS process has stopped.

regex: 746010: (?<user>\S+)\-identity: Update import\-(?<user_2>\S+) (?<domain_name>\S+) \- Import Failed (?<group_name>\S+)$
explanation: Entering the user-identity update import-user username command failed to update a user element. Reasons for failure include the following: timeout, partial update, import aborted, group does not exist, or no reason given.

regex: 746011: (?<user>\S+)\-identity: Total number of users created exceeds the maximum number of (?<max_users>\S+) for this platform$
explanation: The AD group has more than the hard-coded maximum number (64000) of levels. Too many users have been configured in the activated policy.

regex: 746017: (?<user>\S+)\-identity: Update import\-(?<user_2>\S+) (?<domain_name>\S+) issued$
explanation: The user-identity update import-user command has been issued.

regex: 746018: (?<user>\S+)\-identity: Update import\-(?<user_2>\S+) (?<domain_name>\S+) done$
explanation: The user-identity update import-user command has been issued, and the import has been completed successfully.

regex: 746019: (?<user>\S+)\-identity: (?<update>\S+) AD Agent (?<remove>\S+) IP\-(?<user_2>\S+) mapping (?<ad_agent_ip_address>\S+) \- (?<user_ip>\S+)\\(?<domain_name>\S+) failed$
explanation: The ASA failed to update or remove an IP-user mapping on the AD agent.

regex: 747004: State machine changed from state (?<state_name>\S+) to (?<state_name_2>\S+)$
explanation: The cluster FSM has progressed to a new state.

regex: 747006: State machine is at state (?<state_name>\S+)$
explanation: The cluster FSM moved to a stable state; that is, Disabled, Slave, or Master.

regex: 747009: Fatal error due to failure to creat RPC server for module (?<italic_text>.+)$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA failed to create an RPC server.

regex: 747011: Memory allocation failure\. Failed to allocate (?<bytes>\S+)$
explanation: A memory allocation failure occurred in clustering.

regex: 747015: Forcing stray member (?<unit_name>\S+) to leave the cluster$
explanation: A stray cluster member has been found.

regex: 747017: Failed to enroll unit (?<unit_name>\S+) due to maximum member limit\[(?<limit_value>\S+)\] reached$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA failed to enroll a new unit because the maximum member limit has been reached.

regex: 747018: State progression failed due to timeout in module (?<module_name>\S+)$
explanation: The cluster FSM progression has timed out.

regex: 747020: New cluster member (?<unit_name>\S+) rejected due to encryption license mismatch$
explanation: The control unit found that a new joining unit has an incompatible encryption license.

regex: 747025: New cluster member (?<unit_name>\S+) rejected due to firewall mode mismatch\.(?<reason>\S+)$
explanation: A control unit found a joining unit that has an incompatible firewall mode.

regex: 747027: Failed to enroll unit (?<unit_name>\S+) due to insufficient size of cluster pool (?<pool_name>\S+)(?<context_name>\S+)$
explanation: A control unit could not enroll a joining unit because of the size limit of the minimal cluster pool configured.

regex: 747029: Unit (?<unit_name>\S+) is quitting due to Cluster Control Link down\.$
explanation: A unit disabled clustering because of a cluster interface failure.

regex: 747030: Asking data node (?<unit_name>\S+) to quit because it failed (?<interface>\S+) health check (?<x>\S+) times \(last failure on (?<interface_name>\S+)\)\. Clustering must be manually enabled on the unit to rejoin\.$
explanation: An interface health check has failed and the maximum number of rejoin attempts has been exceeded. A data unit has disabled clustering because of an interface health check failure.

regex: 747031: Platform mismatch between cluster control node \((?<platform_type>\S+)\) and joining unit (?<unit_name>\S+) \((?<platform_type_2>\S+)\)\. (?<unit_name_2>\S+) aborting cluster join\.$
explanation: The joining unit's platform type does not match with that of the cluster control unit.

regex: 747032: Service module mismatch between cluster control node \((?<module_name>\S+)\) and joining unit (?<unit_name>\S+) \((?<module_name_2>\S+)\) in slot (?<slot_number>\S+)\. (?<unit_name_2>\S+) aborting cluster join\.$
explanation: The joining unit's external modules are not consistent (module type and order in which they are installed) with those on the cluster control unit.

regex: 747033: Interface mismatch between cluster control node and joining unit (?<unit_name>\S+)\. (?<unit_name_2>\S+) aborting cluster join\.$
explanation: The joining unit's interfaces are not the same as those on the cluster control unit.

regex: 747034: Unit (?<unit_name>\S+) is quitting due to Cluster Control Link down \((?<number_times>\S+) times after last rejoin\)\. Rejoin will be attempted after (?<minutes>\S+) minutes\.$
explanation: Cluster Control Link down and the unit is kicked out with rejoin.

regex: 747035: Unit (?<unit_name>\S+) is quitting due to Cluster Control Link down\. Clustering must be manually enabled on the unit to rejoin\.$
explanation: Cluster Control Link down and the unit is kicked out without rejoin.

regex: 747036: Application software mismatch between cluster control node (?<italic_text>.+) \((?<italic_text_2>.+)\) and joining unit \((?<italic_text_3>.+)\)\. (?<italic_text_4>.+) aborting cluster join\.$
explanation: The applications on control unit and the joining data unit are not the same. Data unit will be kicked out.

regex: 747039: Unit (?<unit_name>\S+) is quitting due to system failure for (?<num>\S+) time\(s\) \(last failure is (?<italic_text>.+)\)\. Rejoin will be attempted after (?<minutes>\S+) minutes\.$
explanation: Clustering system failure, and the unit kicks itself out with rejoin

regex: 747040: Unit (?<unit_name>\S+) is quitting due to system failure for (?<num>\S+) time\(s\) \(last failure is (?<italic_text>.+)\)\. Clustering must be manually enabled on the unit to rejoin\.$
explanation: Clustering system failure and the unit kicks itself out without rejoin

regex: 747042: Control node received the config hash string request message from an unknown member with id (?<cluster_member_id>\S+)$
explanation: Control unit received the config hash string request event.

regex: 747044: Configuration Hash string verification (?<result>\S+)\.$
explanation: The result of configuration hash string comparison..

regex: 748001: Blade (?<slot_number>\S+) in chassis (?<chassis_number>\S+) is leaving the cluster due to a chassis configuration change$
explanation: A cluster control link has changed in the MIO, a cluster group has been removed in the MIO, or a blade module has been removed in the MIO configuration.

regex: 748003: Module (?<slot_number>\S+) in chassis (?<chassis_number>\S+) is leaving the cluster due to a chassis health check failure$
explanation: The blade cannot talk to the MIO, so it relies on the MIO to detect this communication problem and de-bundle the data ports. If data ports are de-bundled, the Secure Firewall ASA will be kicked out by an interface health check.

regex: 748004: Module (?<slot_number>\S+) in chassis (?<chassis_number>\S+) is re\-joining the cluster due to a chassis health check recovery$
explanation: The MIO blade health check has recovered, and the Secure Firewall ASA tries to rejoin the cluster.

regex: 748005: Failed to bundle the ports for module (?<slot_number>\S+) in chassis (?<chassis_number>\S+); clustering is disabled$
explanation: The MIO failed to bundle the ports for itself.

regex: 748006: Asking module (?<slot_number>\S+) in chassis (?<chassis_number>\S+) to leave the cluster due to a port bundling failure$
explanation: The MIO failed to bundle ports for a blade, so the blade has been kicked out.

regex: 748007: Failed to de\-bundle the ports for module (?<slot_number>\S+) in chassis (?<chassis_number>\S+); traffic may be black holed$
explanation: The MIO failed to de-bundle the ports.

regex: 748008: \(\?:CPU\\\ load\\\ (?<percentage>\S+)%%\|memory\\\ load\\\ (?<percentage_2>\S+)%%\) of module (?<slot_number>\S+) in chassis (?<chassis_number>\S+) \((?<member_name>\S+)\) exceeds overflow protection threshold \(\?:CPU\\\ (?<percentage_3>\S+)%%\|Memory\\\ (?<percentage_4>\S+)%%\)\. System may be oversubscribed on member failure\.$
explanation: The CPU load has exceeded (N-1)/N, where N is the total number of active cluster members, or the memory load has exceeded (100 – x) * (N – 1) / N + x, where N is the number of cluster members, and x is the baseline memory usage of the last joining member.

regex: 748009: \(\?:CPU\\\ load\\\ (?<percentage>\S+)%%\|memory\\\ load\\\ (?<percentage_2>\S+)%%\) of chassis (?<chassis_number>\S+) exceeds overflow protection threshold \(\?:CPU\\\ (?<percentage_3>\S+)%%\|Memory\\\ (?<percentage_4>\S+)%%\)\. System may be oversubscribed on chassis failure\.$
explanation: The chassis traffic load exceeded a certain threshold.

regex: 748100: (?<application_name>\S+) (?<application>\S+) status is changed from (?<status>\S+) to (?<status_2>\S+)$
explanation: Detect the application status change from one state to another. Application status change will trigger application health check mechanism.

regex: 748101: Peer unit (?<unit_id>\S+) reported its (?<application_name>\S+) (?<application>\S+) status is (?<status>\S+)$
explanation: Peer unit reported application status change that will trigger application health check mechanism.

regex: 748201: (?<italic_text>.+) (?<application>\S+) on module (?<italic_text_2>.+) in chassis (?<italic_text_3>.+) is (?<status>\S+)$
explanation: Status of the application in the service chain gets changed.

regex: 748202: Module (?<module_id>\S+) in chassis (?<italic_text>.+) is leaving the cluster due to (?<italic_text_2>.+) (?<application_2>\S+) failure$
explanation: Unit will be kicked out of cluster if the application such as vDP, fails.

regex: 748203: Module (?<module_id>\S+) in chassis (?<italic_text>.+) is re\-joining the cluster due to a service chain (?<application>\S+) recovery$
explanation: Unit automatically rejoins the cluster if the service chain application such as vDP, recovers.

regex: 750001: Local:(?<italic_text>.+) :(?<italic_text_2>.+) Remote:(?<italic_text_3>.+) : (?<italic_text_4>.+) Username: (?<user>\S+) Received request to (?<request>\S+) an IPsec tunnel; local traffic selector = (?<italic_text_5>.+) ; remote traffic selector = (?<italic_text_6>.+)$
explanation: A request is being made for an operation on the IPsec tunnel such as a rekey, a request to establish a connection, and so on.

regex: 750002: Local:(?<src_ip>[0-9.]+):(?<src_port>\d+) Remote:(?<dest_ip>[0-9.]+):(?<dest_port>\d+) Username:(?<user>\S+) (?<reason>.*)
explanation: An incoming tunnel or SA initiation request (IKE_INIT_SA request) has been received.

regex: 750003: Local:(?<src_ip>[0-9.]+):(?<src_port>\d+) Remote:(?<dest_ip>[0-9.]+):(?<dest_port>\d+) Username:(?<user>\S+) Negotiation aborted due to ERROR: (?<reason>.*)
explanation: The negotiation of an SA was aborted because of the provided error reason.

regex: 750004: Local: (?<italic_text>.+) Remote: (?<italic_text_2>.+) Username: (?<user>\S+) Sending COOKIE challenge to throttle possible (?<dos>\S+)$
explanation: An incoming connection request was challenged with a cookie based on the cookie challenge thresholds that are configured to prevent a possible DoS attack.

regex: 750006: Local: (?<italic_text>.+) Remote: (?<italic_text_2>.+) Username: (?<user>\S+) SA UP\. Reason: (?<reason>\S+)$
explanation: An SA came up for the given reason, such as for a newly established connection or a rekey.

regex: 750007: Local: (?<italic_text>.+) Remote: r(?<italic_text_2>.+) Username: (?<user>\S+) SA DOWN\. Reason: (?<reason>\S+)$
explanation: An SA was torn down or deleted for the given reason, such as a request by the peer, operator request (via an administrator action), rekey, and so on.

regex: 750008: Local: (?<italic_text>.+) Remote: (?<italic_text_2>.+) Username: (?<user>\S+) SA rejected due to system resource low$
explanation: An SA request was rejected to alleviate a low system resource condition.

regex: 750009: Local: (?<italic_text>.+) Remote: (?<italic_text_2>.+) Username: (?<user>\S+) SA request rejected due to CAC limit reached: Rejection reason: (?<reason>\S+)$
explanation: A Connection Admission Control (CAC) limiting threshold was reached, which caused the SA request to be rejected.

regex: 750010: Local: (?<local_ip>\S+) Remote: (?<remote_ip>\S+) Username:(?<user>\S+) IKEv2 local throttle\-request queue depth threshold of (?<threshold>\S+) reached; increase the window size on peer (?<peer>\S+) for better performance$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA overflowed its throttle request queue to the specified peer, indicating that the peer is slow. The throttle request queue holds requests destined for the peer, which cannot be sent immediately because the maximum number of requests allowed to be in-flight based on the IKEv2 window size were already in-flight. As in-flight requests are completed, requests are pulled off of the throttle request queue and sent to the peer. If the peer is not processing these requests quickly, the throttle queue backs up.

regex: 750011: Tunnel Rejected: Selected IKEv2 encryption algorithm \((?<italic_text>.+) \) is not strong enough to secure proposed IPSEC encryption algorithm \((?<italic_text_2>.+) \)\.$
explanation: The tunnel was rejected because the selected IKEv2 encryption algorithm is not strong enough to secure the proposed IPSEC encryption algorithm.

regex: 750012: Selected IKEv2 encryption algorithm \((?<italic_text>.+) \) is not strong enough to secure proposed IPSEC encryption algorithm \((?<italic_text_2>.+) \)\.$
explanation: The selected IKEv2 encryption algorithm is not strong enough to secure the proposed IPSEC encryption algorithm.

regex: 750013: IKEv2 SA \(iSPI ISPI rRSP rSPI\) Peer Moved: Previous (?<prev_remote_ip>\S+):(?<prev_remote_port>\S+)/(?<prev_local_ip>\S+):(?<prev_local_port>\S+)\. Updated (?<new_remote_ip>\S+):(?<new_remote_port>\S+)/(?<new_local_ip>\S+):(?<new_local_port>\S+)$
explanation: The new mobike feature allows peer IP to be changed without tearing down the tunnel. For example, a mobile device (smartphone) acquires new IP after connecting to a different network.The following list describes the message values:

Reason: invalid SPI notification received for SPI 0x(?<spi>\S+); local traffic selector = Address Range: (?<italic_text_6>.+)\-(?<italic_text_7>.+) Protocol: (?<italic_text_8>.+) Port Range: (?<italic_text_9>.+)\-(?<italic_text_10>.+) ; remote traffic selector = Address Range: (?<italic_text_11>.+)\-(?<italic_text_12>.+) Protocol: (?<italic_text_13>.+) Port Range: (?<italic_text_14>.+)\-(?<italic_text_15>.+)$
