regex: 750016: Local:(?<localip_port>\S+) Remote:(?<remoteip_port>\S+) Username:(?<user>\S+) Need to send a DPD message to peer$
explanation: The device may have terminated a connection to the peer. Dead peer detection needs to be performed for the specified peer to determine if it is still alive. The following describes the message values:

regex: 751001: Failed to complete Diffie\-Hellman operation\. Error: (?<error>\S+)\.$
explanation: A failure to complete a Diffie-Hellman operation occurred, as indicated by the error.

regex: 751002: No pre\-shared key or trustpoint configured for self in tunnel group (?<group>\S+)$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA was unable to find any type of authentication information in the tunnel group that it could use to authenticate itself to the peer.

regex: 751004: No remote authentication method configured for peer in tunnel group (?<group>\S+)$
explanation: A method to authenticate the remote peer was not found in the configuration to allow the connection.

regex: 751006: Certificate authentication failed\. Error: (?<error>\S+)$
explanation: A failure related to certificate authentication occurred.

regex: 751007: Configured attribute not supported for IKEv2\. Attribute: (?<attribute>\S+)$
explanation: A configured attribute could not be applied to the IKE version 2 connection because it is not supported for IKE version 2 connections.

regex: 751010: Local: (?<localip_port>\S+) Remote:(?<remoteip_port>\S+) Username: (?<ph_2___group>\S+) Unable to determine self\-authentication method\. No crypto map setting or tunnel group found\.$
explanation: A method for authenticating the Secure Firewall ASA to the peer could not be found in either the tunnel group or crypto map.

regex: 751011: Failed (?<user>\S+) authentication\. Error: (?<error>\S+)$
explanation: A failure occurred during user authentication within EAP for an IKE version 2 remote access connection.

regex: 751012: Failure occurred during Configuration Mode processing\. Error: (?<error>\S+)$
explanation: A failure occurred during configuration mode processing while settings were being applied to the connection.

regex: 751013: Failed to process Configuration Payload request for attribute (?<attribute_id>\S+)\. Error: (?<error>\S+)$
explanation: The Configuration Payload request failed to process and generate a Configuration Payload response for an attribute that was requested by the peer.

regex: 751014: Warning Configuration Payload request for attribute (?<attribute_id>\S+) could not be processed\. Error: (?<error>\S+)$
explanation: A warning occurred while processing a CP request to generate a CP response for a requested attribute.

regex: 751015: SA request rejected by CAC\. Reason: (?<reason>\S+)$
explanation: The connection was rejected by the call admission control to protect the Secure Firewall ASA based on configured thresholds or conditions indicated by the reason listed.

regex: 751017: Configuration Error: (?<error_description>\S+)\.$
explanation: An error in the configuration that prevented the connection has been detected.

regex: 751018: Terminating the VPN connection attempt from (?<italic_text>.+)\.$
explanation: The tunnel group over which the connection is attempted is not the same as the tunnel group set in the group lock.

regex: 751019: Failed to obtain an (?<licensetype>\S+) license\. Maximum license limit (?<limit>\S+) exceeded\.$
explanation: A session creation failed because the maximum license limit was exceeded, which caused a failure to either initiate or respond to a tunnel request.

regex: 751020: Local:%A:%u Remote:%A:%u Username:%s An %s remote access connection failed\. Attempting to use an NSA Suite B crypto algorithm \(%s\) without an (?<anyconnect>\S+) Premium license\.$
explanation: An IKEv2 remote access tunnel could not be created because the AnyConnect Premium license was applied but explicitly disabled with the anyconnect-essentials command in the webvpn configuration mode.

regex: 751021: (?<italic_text>.+) with (?<variable_3>\S+) encryption is not supported with this version of the (?<anyconnect>\S+) Client\. Please upgrade to the latest Anyconnect Client\.$
explanation: An out-of-date AnyConnect client tried to connect to an Secure Firewall ASA that has IKEv2 with AES-GCM encryption policy configured.

regex: 751022: Tunnel rejected: Crypto Map Policy not found for remote traffic selector (?<rem_ts_start>\S+)/(?<rem_ts_end>\S+)/(?<rem_ts_startport>\S+)/(?<rem_ts_endport>\S+)/(?<rem_ts_protocol>\S+) local traffic selector (?<local_ts_start>\S+)/(?<local_ts_end>\S+)/(?<local_ts_startport>\S+)/(?<local_ts_endport>\S+)/(?<local_ts_protocol>\S+)!$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA was not able to find security policy information for the private networks or hosts indicated in the message. These networks or hosts were sent by the initiator and do not match any crypto ACLs at the Secure Firewall ASA. This is most likely a misconfiguration.

regex: 751025:\s*Local\s*:\s*(?:(?<dest_ip>(?:[\d+.]+|[0-9A-Za-f]*:[0-9A-Za-f]*:[0-9A-Za-f:]*))|(?<dest_host>\S+))\s*:\s*(?<dest_port>\d+)\s+Remote\s*:\s*(?:(?<src_ip>(?:[\d+.]+|[0-9A-Za-f]*:[0-9A-Za-f]*:[0-9A-Za-f:]*))|(?<src_host>\S+))\s*:\s*(?<src_port>\d+)\s+Username\s*:\s*(?<user>.+?(?=\s+Group))\s+Group\s*:\s*(?<group>.+)\s+IPv4\s+[Aa]ddress\s*=\s*(?<assigned_ipv4>\S+)\s+IPv6\s+[Aa]ddress\s*=\s*(?<assigned_ipv6>\S+)\s+(?<vendor_action>\S+)
explanation: This message displays the assigned IP address information for the AnyConnect IKEv2 connection of the specified user.

regex: 751026:\s*Local\s*:\s*(?:(?<dest_ip>(?:[\d+.]+|[0-9A-Za-f]*:[0-9A-Za-f]*:[0-9A-Za-f:]*))|(?<dest_host>\S+))\s*:\s*(?<dest_port>\d+)\s+Remote\s*:\s*(?:(?<src_ip>(?:[\d+.]+|[0-9A-Za-f]*:[0-9A-Za-f]*:[0-9A-Za-f:]*))|(?<src_host>\S+))\s*:\s*(?<src_port>\d+)\s+Username\s*:\s*(?<user>.+?(?=\s+IKEv2))\s+IKEv2\s+Client\s+OS\s*:\s*(?<client_os>.+?(?=\s+Client))\s+Client\s*:\s*(?<client_name>\S+)\s+(?<client_version>.+?)[\s\.]*$
explanation: The indicated user is attempting to connect with the shown operating system and client version.

regex: 751028: Overriding configured keepalive values of threshold:(?<config_threshold>\S+)/retry:(?<config_retry>\S+) to threshold:(?<applied_threshold>\S+)/retry:(?<applied_retry>\S+)\.$
explanation: When configured for distributed-site to site with clustering, the keepalive threshold and retry intervals should be increased to prevent overloading the system. If the configured values are below these required values, the required values will be applied. The following list describes the message values:

regex: 752002: Tunnel Manager Removed entry\. Map Tag = (?<maptag>\S+) \. Map Sequence Number = (?<mapseq>\S+) \.$
explanation: An entry to initiate a tunnel was successfully removed.

regex: 752003: Tunnel Manager dispatching a KEY_ACQUIRE message to IKEv2\. Map Tag = (?<maptag>\S+) \. Map Sequence Number = (?<mapseq>\S+)$
explanation: An attempt is being made to initiate an IKEv2 tunnel that was based on the crypto map indicated.

regex: 752004: Tunnel Manager dispatching a KEY_ACQUIRE message to IKEv1\. Map Tag = (?<maptag>\S+) \. Map Sequence Number = (?<mapseq>\S+)$
explanation: An attempt is being made to initiate an IKEv1 tunnel that was based on the crypto map indicated.

regex: 752005: Tunnel Manager failed to dispatch a KEY_ACQUIRE message\. Memory may be low\. Map Tag = (?<maptag>\S+) \. Map Sequence Number = (?<mapseq>\S+)$
explanation: An attempt to dispatch a tunnel initiation attempt failed because of an internal error, such as a memory allocation failure.

regex: 752006: Tunnel Manager failed to dispatch a KEY_ACQUIRE message\. Probable mis\-configuration of the crypto map or tunnel\-group\. Map Tag = (?<tag>\S+) \. Map Sequence Number = (?<num>\S+) SRC Addr:(?<address>\S+) port(?<italic_text>.+) Dst Addr:(?<address_2>\S+) port:(?<port>\S+) \.$
explanation: An attempt to dispatch a tunnel initiation attempt failed because of a configuration error of the indicated crypto map or associated tunnel group.

regex: 752007: Tunnel Manager failed to dispatch a KEY_ACQUIRE message\. Entry already in Tunnel Manager\. Map Tag = (?<maptag>\S+) \. Map Sequence Number = (?<mapseq>\S+)$
explanation: An attempt was made to re-add an existing entry into the tunnel manager.

regex: 752012: IKEv (?<protocol>\S+) was unsuccessful at setting up a tunnel\. Map Tag = (?<maptag>\S+) \. Map Sequence Number = (?<mapseq>\S+) \.$
explanation: The indicated protocol failed to initiate a tunnel using the configured crypto map.

regex: 752013: Tunnel Manager dispatching a KEY_ACQUIRE message to IKEv2 after a failed attempt\. Map Tag = (?<maptag>\S+) \. Map Sequence Number = (?<mapseq>\S+) \.$
explanation: The tunnel manager is attempting to initiate the tunnel again after it failed.

regex: 752014: Tunnel Manager dispatching a KEY_ACQUIRE message to IKEv1 after a failed attempt\. Map Tag = (?<maptag>\S+) \. Map Sequence Number = (?<mapseq>\S+) \.$
explanation: The tunnel manager is falling back and attempting to initiate the tunnel using IKE version 1 after the tunnel failed.

regex: 752015: Tunnel Manager has failed to establish an L2L SA\. All configured IKE versions failed to establish the tunnel\. Map Tag = (?<maptag>\S+) \. Map Sequence Number = (?<mapseq>\S+) \.$
explanation: An attempt to bring up an L2L tunnel to a peer failed after trying with all configured protocols.

regex: 752016: IKEv (?<protocol>\S+) was successful at setting up a tunnel\. Map Tag = (?<maptag>\S+) \. Map Sequence Number = (?<mapseq>\S+)$
explanation: The indicated protocol (IKE version 1 or IKE version 2) successfully created an L2L tunnel.

explanation: A fail-close option was set for a service policy, and a particular inspect received an IPv6, IP64, or IP46 packet. Based on the fail-close option setting, this syslog message is generated and the packet is dropped.

regex: 769001: UPDATE: (?<asa>\S+) image '(?<src>\S+)' was added to system boot list$
explanation: The system image has been updated. The name of a file previously downloaded onto the system has been added to the system boot list.

regex: 769002: UPDATE: (?<asa>\S+) image '(?<src>\S+)' was copied to '(?<dest>\S+)'$
explanation: The system image has been updated. An image file has been copied onto the system.

regex: 769003: UPDATE: (?<asa>\S+) image '(?<src>\S+)' was renamed to '(?<dest>\S+)'$
explanation: The system image has been updated. An existing image file has been renamed to an image file name in the system boot list.

regex: 769005: UPDATE: (?<asa>\S+) image '(?<image_name>\S+)' passed verification$
explanation: This is a notification message indicating that the image passed verification.

regex: 769006: UPDATE: (?<asa>\S+) boot system image '(?<image_name>\S+)' was not found on disk$
explanation: This is an error message indicating that the file configured in the boot system list could not be located on disk.

regex: 769007: UPDATE: Image version is (?<version_number>\S+)$
explanation: This message appears when the device is upgraded.

regex: 769009: UPDATE: Image booted (?<image_name>\S+) is different from boot images$
explanation: This is an error message appears after upgrading the device indicating that the file configured is different from the existing list of boot images.

regex: 770003: (?<resource>\S+) resource allocation is less than the minimum requirement of (?<value>\S+)\.$
explanation: The CPU or memory resource allocation to the Secure Firewall ASA virtual machine is less than the minimum requirement for this platform. If this condition persists, performance will be lower than normal.

regex: 772005: REAUTH: (?<user_2>\S+) '(?<user>\S+)' passed authentication$
explanation: The user authenticated successfully after changing the password.

regex: 772006: REAUTH: (?<user_2>\S+) '(?<user>\S+)' failed authentication$
explanation: The user entered the wrong password while trying to change it. As a result, the password was not changed.
A ScanSafe server is configured, and traffic matches a policy that has been configured to redirect the connection to the ScanSafe server for content scanning and other malware protection services.
If the source IP address and port of the new ScanSafe redirected connection matches the existing connection, then the ASA drops the new connection and this syslog message is generated.
The traffic has been matched and does not need to be redirected to the ScanSafe server for content scanning, but can be sent directly to the intended web server.
The primary ScanSafe server is not reachable on either of the configured HTTP or HTTPS ports.
The primary ScanSafe server is reachable on both of the configured HTTP and HTTPS ports.
If the primary ScanSafe server becomes unreachable, the ASA checks the connectivity to the configured backup ScanSafe server; if the backup server is reachable, it becomes the active server.

regex: 776001: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<italic_text>.+) (?<error>\S+)\.\\n$
explanation: An error occurred while using this configured source IP address to set up an SXP connection.

regex: 776002: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<italic_text>.+) (?<error>\S+)\.\\n$
explanation: An error occurred while parsing an SXP message.

regex: 776003: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<italic_text>.+) (?<error>\S+)\.\\n$
explanation: An SXP configuration error occurred. The connection cannot be set up correctly.

regex: 776005: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<italic_text>.+) (?<sgt>\S+)\.\\n$
explanation: An SXP binding update error has occurred.

regex: 776006: CTS SXP: Internal error: (?<error>\S+)$
explanation: The CTS SXP system encountered an internal failure.

regex: 776007: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<italic_text>.+) (?<italic_text_2>.+)\.\\n$
explanation: The CTS SXP system encountered an internal failure, because the SXP connection with the specified instance number changed its state to off.

regex: 776008: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<italic_text>.+) (?<italic_text_2>.+)\.\\n$
explanation: The SXP connection with the specified instance number changed state.

regex: 776010: CTS SXP: SXP default source IP is changed (?<italic_text>.+) \-\-> (?<italic_text_2>.+)\.$
explanation: The SXP default source IP address has been changed on this device.

regex: 776011: CTS SXP: (?<italic_text>.+)$
explanation: The SXP feature has changed operational state and works only when the feature is enabled.

regex: 776012: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<italic_text>.+) (?<italic_text_2>.+)\.\\n$
explanation: The specified SXP timer started.

regex: 776013: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<italic_text>.+) (?<italic_text_2>.+)\.\\n$
explanation: The specified SXP timer stopped.

regex: 776014: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<action>\S+) (?<italic_text>.+)\.\\n$
explanation: The SXP received a binding forwarding request. The request comes from the binding manager when it wants SXP to broadcast the latest net binding changes within the binding manager.

regex: 776015: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<italic_text>.+) (?<sgname>\S+)\.\\n$
explanation: The SXP forwarded binding to the peer.

regex: 776016: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<sgname>\S+) (?<sgt>\S+)\.\\n$
explanation: Binding changed in the SXP database.

regex: 776017: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<sgname>\S+) (?<italic_text>.+)\.\\n$
explanation: Binding was deleted in the SXP database.

regex: 776018: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<sgname>\S+) (?<italic_text>.+)\.\\n$
explanation: Binding was aded in the SXP database.

regex: 776019: CTS SXP: Configured source IP (?<italic_text>.+) (?<sgname>\S+)\.\\n$
explanation: The SXP updated the binding manager with the binding change.

regex: 776020: CTS SXP: Unable to locate egress (?<interface>\S+) to peer (?<italic_text>.+)\.$
explanation: The ASA cannot locate the egress interface to the SXP peer.

regex: 776251: CTS SGT\-MAP: Binding (?<italic_text>.+)\->(?<sgname>\S+) from (?<sgt>\S+) added to binding manager\.$
explanation: Binding from the specified source was added to the binding manager.

regex: 776252: CTS SGT\-MAP: Binding (?<italic_text>.+)\->(?<sgname>\S+) from (?<sgt>\S+) deleted from binding manager\.$
explanation: Binding from the specified source was deleted from the binding manager. Binding from the specified source was added to the binding manager.

regex: 776253: CTS SGT\-MAP: Binding (?<italic_text>.+)\->(?<new>\S+) from (?<sgname>\S+) changed from old sgt: (?<sgt>\S+) from old source(?<italic_text_2>.+)$
explanation: A particular IP to SGT binding has changed in the binding manager.

regex: 776254: CTS SGT\-MAP: Binding manager unable to (?<action>\S+) binding (?<italic_text>.+)\->(?<sgname>\S+) from (?<sgt>\S+)\.$
explanation: The binding manager cannot insert, delete, or update the binding

regex: 776302: CTS Policy: Unknown security\-group tag (?<sgt>\S+) referenced in policies$
explanation: The security group tag referenced in the policy was unknown and the lookup in the security group table failed. However, the policy referencing the tag can still be enforced.

regex: 776309: CTS Policy: Previously known security\-group tag (?<sgt>\S+) is now unknown$
explanation: In the newly downloaded security group table on the ASA, a previously known security group tag no longer exists. There is no change in policy status, and the policy can still be enforced.
The Secure Firewall ASA tries to create an inner connection for a VXLAN packet, but the VXLAN packet has an invalid segment ID.

regex: 778002: VXLAN: There is no VNI (?<interface>\S+) for segment\-id\. Packet was discarded (?<segment_id>\S+)$
explanation: A decapsulated ingress VXLAN packet is discarded, because the segment ID in the VXLAN header does not match the segment ID of any VNI interface configured on the Secure Firewall ASA.

regex: 778003: VXLAN: Invalid VXLAN segment\-id (?<segment_id>\S+) for (?<protocol>\S+) from (?<ifc_name>\S+) :\(IP\-address/port\) to (?<ifc_name_2>\S+) :\(IP\-address/port\) in FP\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA Fast Path sees a VXLAN packet with an invalid segment ID.

regex: 778004: VXLAN: Invalid VXLAN header for (?<protocol>\S+) from (?<ifc_name>\S+) :\(IP\-address/port\) to (?<ifc_name_2>\S+) :\(IP\-address/port\) in FP\.$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA VTEP sees a VXLAN packet with an invalid VXLAN header.

regex: 778005: VXLAN: Packet with VXLAN segment\-id (?<segment_id>\S+) from (?<ifc_name>\S+) is denied by FP L2 check\.$

regex: 778006: VXLAN: Invalid VXLAN UDP checksum from (?<ifc_name>\S+) :\(IP\-address/port\) to (?<ifc_name_2>\S+) :\(IP\-address/port\) in FP\.$

regex: 778007: VXLAN: Packet from (?<ifc_name>\S+) :IP\-address/port to IP\-address/port was discarded due to invalid NVE peer\.$

regex: 778008: VXLAN: There is no VNI (?<interface>\S+) for segment\-id\. Packet was discarded$
explanation: The packet was discarded.

regex: 779001: STS: Out\-tag lookup failed for in\-tag (?<segment_id>\S+) of (?<protocol>\S+) from (?<ifc_name>\S+) :(?<ip_address>\S+) /(?<port>\S+) to (?<ip_address_2>\S+) /(?<port_2>\S+) \.$

regex: 779003: STS: Failed to read tag\-switching table \- (?<reason>\S+)$

regex: 779004: STS: Failed to write tag\-switching table \- (?<reason>\S+)$

regex: 779005: STS: Failed to parse tag\-switching request from http \- (?<reason>\S+)$

regex: 779006: STS: Failed to save tag\-switching table to flash \- (?<reason>\S+)$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA tried to save the tag-switching table to flash memory, but failed.

regex: 779007: STS: Failed to replicate tag\-switching table to peer \- (?<reason>\S+)$
explanation: The Secure Firewall ASA attempts to replicate the tag-switching table to the failover standby unit or clustering data units, but failed to do so.

regex: 780001: RULE ENGINE: Started compilation for access\-group transaction \- (?<italic_text>.+)\.$

explanation: The rule engine has finished compilation for a transaction. Taking access group as an example, the description of the transaction is the command line input of the access group itself.

regex: 780003: RULE ENGINE: Started compilation for nat transaction \- (?<description_of_the_transaction>\S+)\.$
explanation: The rule engine has started compilation for a NAT transaction. The description of the transaction is the command line input of the nat command itself.

regex: 780004: RULE ENGINE: Finished compilation for nat transaction \- (?<description_of_the_transaction>\S+)\.$
explanation: The rule engine has finished compilation for a NAT transaction. The description of the transaction is the command line input of the nat command itself.

explanation: The CPU has reached temperature under secondary alarm temperature setting for low temperature and such alarm is enabled.
